plugins.name: core

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Read-only code review with scans, a reviewer and verify agent, and a findings ledger.

plugins.name: testdata
plugins.description: Synthetic test data from a blind designer agent and the project's seeded generator.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: HTML design frames rendered to review PNGs, a frame checker, storyboards, annotated question sheets, and the screen review with a screen-reader agent.

plugins.name: stack-tauri-rust
plugins.description: Tauri app driver under a memory cap, and a disk check for Rust build leftovers.

plugins.name: stack-web
plugins.description: Web app driver: the project's servers and a headless Chromium under a memory cap.

plugins.name: e2e
plugins.description: A blind tester agent walks the test-data journeys through the app; replayed drafts go in the review ledger.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Releases on the owner's command, through the project's release commands and workflows, a yes before each step.
